import json,statistics,math
f=json.load(open('.local/smart-takes-2026-10-29/audio-evidence.json'))[0]['frames']
def q(a,p): return sorted(a)[int((len(a)-1)*p)]
r=[x['rms'] for x in f]; print('rms quantiles',[(p,q(r,p)) for p in [.01,.1,.2,.3,.5,.8,.95]])
for n in [1,5,10,20]:
 b=[sum(r[i:i+n])/len(r[i:i+n]) for i in range(0,len(r),n)]
 threshold=q(b,.1)*1.2
 spans=[]; start=None
 for i,v in enumerate(b+[math.inf]):
  if v<=threshold:
   if start is None:start=i*n*.01
  elif start is not None:
   if i*n*.01-start>.3:spans.append((round(start,2),round(i*n*.01,2)))
   start=None
 print(n,'floor',q(b,.1),'quiet span count',len(spans),'duration',sum(e-s for s,e in spans),'first',spans[:8])
